text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! I beat McQueen,
who everyone calls a senior powerhouse!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Now that proves I can
hold my own in the Senior Class too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, which race are we aiming for next!?
Bring on whatever race comes our way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Judging from today's results, there's no doubt
that she has what it takes to succeed on the big stage...!
choice_data_list: Next, let's challenge the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waah! That's a suuuper big race!
That's the race the President won too, right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this!
I'm definitely going to win too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after that—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Good work on training, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Today was another super fulfilling day!
I'm in top condition!
choice_data_list: Let's keep this up and give it our all in the next race too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh?
The one running over there is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Not yet... Just one more lap...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's already past closing time, and yet...
she's still going to run... McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, being able to project such fierce spirit
is proof of a true powerhouse.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
McQueen's really pushing herself, isn't she?
I guess it's because she lost that race?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! But no matter how many times you challenge me, I'm still gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You were watching too, right, Prez?
My race with McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I wouldn't count on getting
the same result next time."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She will surely make even greater leaps from here on out.
...I would love nothing more than to run alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on!? I'm the one who won, right?
If you wanna run, shouldn't it be with me!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing McQueen as she is now, that was my judgment.
She possesses what you lack."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Something I'm lacking...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Teio, let me make this unequivocally clear.
If you were to race against her right now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You will surely lose.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Y-You'll never know
unless you try!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right now I'm firing on all cylinders, in top shape, you know?!
And you're still saying McQueen is gonna win?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, no matter how many times I try.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having achieved great results at the Tenno Sho (Spring), Tokai Teio was undoubtedly in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Symboli Rudolf's words
signaled turbulence ahead.
